sources.observation: The stone terraces step up the slope beneath a dark canopy and deep projecting glass bays.

sources.observation: An outdoor staircase reaches two rectangular portals under a projecting glazed bay. Large limestone slabs continue around the side walls.

limitations: The building and path outlines use the two PMTiles fragments and native map nodes. Roof terraces, door spacing, and stair grades are fitted to exterior photographs and available elevation samples.
